title: Investment Property & Development finance

seo.title: Property Investment Bridging & Development Finance for Companies & SPVs | CredX

content:
Short-term property finance for corporate borrowers acquiring, refinancing or improving investment and development property. Funding is available only for business or investment purposes. CredX does not offer residential mortgages or loans to individual consumers.

What is Property Investment Bridging & Development Finance?

It is a short-term facility that allows you to move quickly on an investment or development opportunity — for example an auction acquisition, a refurbishment, or a purchase that needs to complete before longer-term funding is in place. The facility is repaid from an agreed exit such as sale or refinance.
